profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer
profile.summary: Technical Solutions Engineer at Google Nest, Smart Home team.

positions.title: Systems Engineer
positions.description:
Systems Engineer@ Nest Partner Engineering
・Developed local home execution / seamless setup virtual device supporting HTTP/TCP/UDP
・Developed WebRTC livestream app using Flutter for Android, enabling video stream from camera devicesUnblocked engineer team implementing feature to be able to deliver production app to the partner in time
・Integrated full stack smart home service into Firebase database and functions in JavaScript, providing developers and QA teams to test and simulate all new smart home devices and features
・Created account linking validation feature into smart home Test Suite using Angular to partners self-test OAuth issues
・Engage with 50+ partners during the Smart Home Developer Summit through pre-recorded video content and in-person group sessions, presented account linking, AppFlip, local execution and new features
・Held offline codelab sessions for developers and provided 1:1 coach and troubleshooting

positions.title: Software Development Engineer Intern
positions.description:
•	Investigated, designed and built Ethernet hardware to support Industrial IoT (Internet of Things) applications for AGV product
•	Ported open source RTOS to NXP LPC ARM Cortex-M3 CPU to realize TCP/IP communication, self-driving vehicle control and safety system program using multithreading, achieved round trip time reduction (800 ms to 1 ms)
•	Integrated and implemented Raspberry-Pi with LIDAR, ultrasound and IR sensors for vehicle auto-stop safety system 
•	Developed web GUI using HTML, PHP and MySQL for vehicle remote management and vision training database

positions.title: Instructional Student Assistant
positions.description:
Teaching Assistant
Course: Network Security, Advanced Algorithm Design, Big Data Technology
•	Generated questions and graded for homework assignment/exam sheets
•	Helped students bring-up knowledge of system security, computer algorithm, big data

positions.title: Technical Director
positions.description:
•Developed strategies for program trading using Power Language in stock market of Taiwan and USA.
•Led the team and the instructor to open courses for students, increased annual service revenue by 50%

company.name: Red Envelope Program Development Co., Ltd

positions.title: Hardware Design Engineer
positions.description:
•Automobile grade circuit design - design circuit board for automobile digital audio products, car audio system amplifier, Digital Radio receiver module and Bluetooth module for major Japanese, American and Germany electronics companies. 
•Product verification and debug - Cooperate with software engineer for new product development; conduct manufacturing testing program and develop product specification and manual. 
•Work cross functionally with production engineer, quality control team and customer service team to collect production data, apply statistic method and 6-sigma techniques to improve manufacturing parameter and enhance quality prediction and control

positions.title: Hardware Engineer
positions.description:
•Design and verify function of circuit mainboards of personal computers and POS computers 
•Responsible for first production verification, optimizing layout and reduce costs by selecting alternative components for production lines
•Utilize Excels and statistics to conduct data analysis and create reports to customers

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant
positions.description: Developed a highly feasible Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor (PMSM) Driving System which adopt a sensorless driving method, which allows freezer or air conditioner reduce energy consumption.

positions.title: Graduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Preparing materials for labs, lecturing experiment principles to students, and guide student groups to complete experiments.

projects.title: 3D Computer Graphic using ARM CPU
projects.description:
•	Developed a microcomputer system using ARM CoreM3 based CPU with LCD display to graph 2D and 3D objects
•	Implemented graphing techniques of 3D to 2D projection, rotation transformation, diffuse reflection, and shading

projects.title: Data Puzzle on Android
projects.description:
•	Developed a distributed secure data storage solution to help user store data in the hybrid cloud
•	Implemented techniques of encryption, error detection and correction 
•	Integrated Google Firebase and Google Drive API for managing user account information and user file metadata

patents.title: Identification device of slots
patents.description: The utility model provides an identification device of slots. The identification device is mainly applicable to a mainboard with a plurality of processors, wherein a plurality of processor slots and a plurality of expansion card slots are arranged on the mainboard, and each of the processor slots is in electric connection with each of the expansion card slots correspondingly.

patents.title: Multi Processor Platform
patents.description: The utility model provides a multiprocessor platform.
